evaluation_population: Heldout runs, selected positive-thickness nodes, source times10..100ms, all3 displacement components; t0 is excluded from error aggregates.
displacement_relative_l2: sqrt(sum((u_prediction-u_FEM)^2)/sum(u_FEM^2)), summed over run,node,time,xyz. Denominator uses displacement, not absolute position.
displacement_rmse_native_units: Displacement COMPONENT RMSE in mm: sqrt(mean((u_prediction-u_FEM)^2)) over run,node,time,xyz.
node_vector_rmse: sqrt(mean(||u_prediction-u_FEM||_2^2)) over run,node,time, equal to sqrt(3) times component RMSE for3 components.
spatial_weighting: Uniform nodal weighting. No element-volume or nodal-mass weighting.
zero_displacement_baseline: Prediction u=0; displacement-relative L2 is exactly1 when FEM displacement energy is nonzero.
training_mean_field_baseline: At each aligned node,time,component, predict mean displacement from112 training runs only.
normalization: Input, coordinates and target normalization fitted on112 training runs only. Twelve internal validation runs select checkpoint;7 official validation runs act as heldout evaluation.
timing: GPU training seconds cover epoch loops with validation/checkpoint writing. Reported inference seconds cover synchronized warm forward calls, excluding loading, transfers and file I/O.
memory: cuda_peak_allocated_bytes is PyTorch tensor allocation, excluding driver/context and other processes. peak_sampled_rss_bytes is maximum sampled at initialization/epoch boundaries, not a true process peak.
limits: These metrics validate displacement interpolation on a fixed mesh and fixed velocity. They do not establish stress, plastic strain, energy conservation, contact forces, damage, failure probability, new geometry, or appliance drop performance.
